true: echo a b c d e f | xargs -n2 echo > /dev/null
i=0; while [ $i -lt 1000 ]; do echo x$i; i=$((i + 1)); done > /dev/null
n=0; for i in $(seq 1 1000); do n=$((n + i)); done
while read a b c; do x="$a-$b"; case $x in line5*) y=$c;; esac; done < $D/l100.txt
head -n 50 $D/l100.txt | while read a b c; do echo $a | cut -c1-3 > /dev/null; done
i=0; while [ $i -lt 100 ]; do basename /a/b/c.txt > /dev/null; i=$((i + 1)); done
cat $D/words.txt | cut -d, -f2 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 3 > /dev/null
